description: Energy balance and weight trajectory. Base resting metabolic rate via Mifflin-St Jeor; activity via PAL multiplier; weight change via the energy-balance identity (brief 2). Organ/system level; calibratable per user in Layer 3.

msj_weight_coeff.citation: Mifflin et al. 1990, Am J Clin Nutr (Mifflin-St Jeor RMR equation)

msj_height_coeff.citation: Mifflin et al. 1990, Am J Clin Nutr

msj_age_coeff.citation: Mifflin et al. 1990, Am J Clin Nutr
msj_age_coeff.notes: Subtracted: RMR declines ~5 kcal/day per year of age.

msj_sex_offset_male.citation: Mifflin et al. 1990, Am J Clin Nutr

msj_sex_offset_female.citation: Mifflin et al. 1990, Am J Clin Nutr

rmr_individual_sd.citation: Mifflin et al. 1990 (SEE ~10% of measured RMR); Donahoo 2004
rmr_individual_sd.notes: Mifflin-St Jeor predicts true RMR to within ~10% for ~80% of people. population_sd drives the prior on the per-user RMR multiplier (Layer 3 calibrates it).

kcal_per_kg_fat.notes: First-order energy-balance constant. Known to overestimate long-run loss (Hall 2011 dynamic model) — flag as a v1 simplification; refine with Hall's model later.

HbA1c.notes: Glycemic marker. Future metabolic-module output under chronic caloric/glycemic load; not modeled in v1.
